description: List all tags in the vault with usage counts. Supports substring filtering, minimum count threshold, and sort order. Nested tags (e.g. area/work) include a parent field.

minCount.description: Only return tags used in at least this many notes.

pattern.description: Substring filter on tag name. Example: "work" matches "work" and "area/work".

sort.description: Sort by usage count descending (default) or alphabetically.

name: list_tags
